name: Festa Estranha
source:
You are an exchange student at a calourada (a brazilian college party) and it's already late, but your ride has completely vanished, so you can't go home. So what do you do? You walk around the campus, talking to different characters who may help you find your friend. But remember: it is a calourada, so you might find yourself in some pretty strange situations.

Festa Estranha (Trap Party) is an escape the room about learning how to deal with uncomfortable social situations, and having fun in unexpected ways. It's a game that simulates the dynamics of a party, where every conversation and decision taken has consequences for the characters, and modifies the game environment.

[From [url=https://faisca.itch.io/festa-estranha]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
身为交换生，你参加了巴西大学的迎新派对。天色已晚，原本要载你回去的人却没了踪影。现在该怎么办？在校园里四处走走，跟遇见的人聊聊，说不定有人能帮你找到朋友。不过别忘了，这可是迎新派对，遇上什么怪事都不稀奇。

《怪诞派对》是一款逃脱游戏，讲的是如何应付令人不自在的社交场面，如何从意想不到的地方找到乐趣。游戏模拟了派对上人与人的互动，每一场交谈、每一个决定，都将影响在场的人，也会改变你身处的环境。

［摘自[url=https://faisca.itch.io/festa-estranha]itch.io[/url]］
